item.title: Cost Per Lead vs Cost Per Booked Job — The 2 Numbers
item.description:
Cost per lead is the number they WANT you watching — and it's a lie. The only number that pays your mortgage is cost per booked job. Angi ~$542, Thumbtack ~$250, Google LSA ~$168. Why a 'cheap' shared lead is a bidding war and an 'expensive' exclusive lead is actually cheaper — plus the one division that cuts half your ad spend.

item.title: How to Get More Google Reviews (The Contractor Playbook)
